text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I updated your data. If we're starting 
measurements, the setup is—... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...Could growing a year older have 
caused a major shift in your calculations?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to hold back. Please, 
speak your mind clearly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For you to hesitate this much... 
...Shakir-san. I'm already prepared.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry about me. ...Now, go 
right ahead.
